meta.description: Kickoff 62, the check at the peak phase on ibm_fez, drawn on measured readout, in three jobs. Four chains L1-M-L3 drawn after it by the rule's fixed procedure, the readout screen on the survey's measured values (chain_draw): 35-19-15, 20-21-36, 109-110-111 and 99-95-94.   phi* = 180 - theta_R1 wrapped to [0, 360) and rounded to the nearest whole degree, from the point estimate);

def bit_matrix(keys, n):
    """Outcome strings (Qiskit order, clbit 0 rightmost) as a (len(keys), n) 0/1 matrix, column i = clbit i."""
    keys = [k.replace(" ", "") for k in keys]
    if not keys:
        return np.zeros((0, n), dtype=np.int64)
    a = np.frombuffer("".join(keys).encode(), dtype=np.uint8).reshape(len(keys), n).astype(np.int64) - 48
    return a[:, ::-1]


def survey(labels0, counts0):
    """Per qubit P(1|0) from S0, P(0|1) from S1, the copies pooled, and e = (P(1|0) + P(0|1)) / 2; each copy's values."""
    n = labels0[0]["n_qubits"]
    ones, tot = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list)
    for lab, cts in zip(labels0, counts0):
        keys = list(cts)
        B = bit_matrix(keys, n)
        v = np.array([cts[k] for k in keys], dtype=np.int64)
        ones[lab["circuit"]].append((lab["copy"], v @ B))
        tot[lab["circuit"]].append((lab["copy"], int(v.sum())))
    for k in ones:
        ones[k].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        tot[k].sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    s0 = sum(x for _, x in ones["S0"])
    s1 = sum(x for _, x in ones["S1"])
    n0 = sum(x for _, x in tot["S0"])
    n1 = sum(x for _, x in tot["S1"])
    p10 = s0 / n0
    p01 = 1 - s1 / n1
    by0 = [x / t for (_, x), (_, t) in zip(ones["S0"], tot["S0"])]
    by1 = [1 - x / t for (_, x), (_, t) in zip(ones["S1"], tot["S1"])]
    return {str(q): {"P1_given_0": float(p10[q]), "P0_given_1": float(p01[q]), "e": float((p10[q] + p01[q]) / 2),
                     "P1_given_0_by_copy": [float(x[q]) for x in by0], "P0_given_1_by_copy": [float(x[q]) for x in by1]}
            for q in range(n)}, {"S0": [t for _, t in tot["S0"]], "S1": [t for _, t in tot["S1"]]}


def published_of(snap, qs):
    """Published readout error, P(1|0) and P(0|1) per qubit from a saved snapshot (properties.to_dict())."""
    out = {}
    for q in qs:
        d = {x["name"]: x["value"] for x in snap["qubits"][int(q)]}
        out[str(q)] = {k: (None if d.get(k) is None else float(d.get(k))) for k in PFIELDS}
    return out


def survey_record(labels0, counts0, snap):
    sv, shots = survey(labels0, counts0)
    pub = published_of(snap, sv)
    for q, v in sv.items():
        v["published"] = pub[q]
        v["above_3pct_measured"] = v["e"] > RO_MAX
        p = pub[q]["readout_error"]
        v["above_3pct_published"] = None if p is None else p > RO_MAX
    e = np.array([v["e"] for v in sv.values()])
    p = np.array([v["published"]["readout_error"] for v in sv.values() if v["published"]["readout_error"] is not None])
    meas_above = sorted(int(q) for q, v in sv.items() if v["above_3pct_measured"])
    pub_above = sorted(int(q) for q, v in sv.items() if v["above_3pct_published"])
    summ = {"n_qubits": len(sv), "shots": shots, "e_min": float(e.min()), "e_max": float(e.max()), "e_median": float(np.median(e)),
            "n_measured_above_3pct": len(meas_above), "measured_above_3pct": meas_above,
            "p_min": float(p.min()), "p_max": float(p.max()), "p_median": float(np.median(p)),
            "n_published_above_3pct": len(pub_above), "published_above_3pct": pub_above,
            "above_3pct_both": sorted(set(meas_above) & set(pub_above)), "above_3pct_measured_only": sorted(set(meas_above) - set(pub_above)),
            "above_3pct_published_only_count": len(set(pub_above) - set(meas_above))}
    return {"rule": "k62-rule.md: e = (P(1|0) + P(0|1)) / 2 from S0 and S1 with the copies pooled; the published readout error at the stamp in force at the survey's submission recorded beside; the survey's values used only for the draw's 3% screen",
            "qubits": sv, "summary": summ}


def synthetic_survey_counts(labels0, stated, rng):
    """Counts for the survey's labels drawn at stated (P(1|0), P(0|1)) per qubit, each qubit's bit independently."""
    n = labels0[0]["n_qubits"]
    p10 = np.array([stated[q][0] for q in range(n)])
    p01 = np.array([stated[q][1] for q in range(n)])
    shots = 2_000
    out = []
    for lab in labels0:
        if lab["circuit"] == "S0":
            bits = rng.random((shots, n)) < p10
        else:
            bits = rng.random((shots, n)) >= p01
        strs = ["".join("1" if x else "0" for x in row[::-1]) for row in bits]
        c = defaultdict(int)
        for s in strs:
            c[s] += 1
        out.append(dict(c))
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- job 2's readout circuits (analyse_60.readout)
def readout(labels2, counts2, order):
    """P(1|0) from P10 and P(0|1) from P01, per M, pooled over the copies, with each copy's value."""
    ones = defaultdict(list)
    for lab, cts in zip(labels2, counts2):
        if lab["circuit"] in READOUT:
            o, t = A57.m_ones(lab, cts)
            ones[(str(lab["M"]), lab["circuit"])].append((lab["copy"], o, t))
    out = {}
    for M in order:
        p10 = sorted(ones[(M, "P10")])
        p01 = sorted(ones[(M, "P01")])
        out[M] = {"P1_given_0": sum(x[1] for x in p10) / sum(x[2] for x in p10),
                  "P1_given_0_by_copy": [x[1] / x[2] for x in p10],
                  "P0_given_1": 1 - sum(x[1] for x in p01) / sum(x[2] for x in p01),
                  "P0_given_1_by_copy": [1 - x[1] / x[2] for x in p01],
                  "shots": {"P10": [x[2] for x in p10], "P01": [x[2] for x in p01]}}
        out[M]["mean_of_the_two"] = (out[M]["P1_given_0"] + out[M]["P0_given_1"]) / 2
    return out


def analyse(labels1, counts1, labels2, counts2, order, phistar):
    r = A59.analyse(labels1, counts1, labels2, counts2, order, phistar)
    r["H62"] = r.pop("H59")
    r["readout_measured"] = readout(labels2, counts2, order)
    return r

def _stamp_of(path):
    return datetime.strptime(path.name[len("snapshot-"):-len(".json")], "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def published_at(t, qs):
    snaps = {}
    for d in (HERE / "walk-62" / "snapshots", HERE / "stamps-62"):
        for p in d.glob("snapshot-*.json") if d.exists() else []:
            snaps.setdefault(_stamp_of(p), p)
    before = [s for s in snaps if s <= t]
    if not before:
        return None
    s = max(before)
    d = json.loads(snaps[s].read_text())
    return {"stamp_utc": s.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "snapshot": snaps[s].parent.name + "/" + snaps[s].name, "qubits": published_of(d, qs)}


def ts(s):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(str(s).replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(timezone.utc)

def synthetic_readout():
    """analyse_60.synthetic_readout, unchanged but for the verdict's name: analyse_57's job 2 construction (the same model
    and stated offsets), with the two readout circuits added per chain at stated P(1|0) and P(0|1); built to AGREE and to
    DISAGREE; the analysis must return each and recover the readout."""
    W = A57.W
    ik = sorted(W.wait_test_ideal())
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    s2 = lambda x: math.sin(math.radians(x) / 2) ** 2

    def w_counts(f, n):
        p = {k: f / 32 for k in ik}
        p["000001"] = 1 - f
        ks = list(p)
        x = rng.multinomial(n, [p[k] for k in ks])
        return {k: int(v) for k, v in zip(ks, x) if v}

    def r_counts(p1, n, bits=6):
        o = int(rng.binomial(n, min(max(p1, 0.0), 1.0)))
        if bits == 1:
            return {"0": n - o, "1": o}
        return {"0" * bits: n - o, "1" + "0" * (bits - 1): o}

    order = ["11", "22", "33", "44"]
    thR = {"11": 10, "22": -40, "33": 100, "44": -150}
    ro = {"11": (0.01, 0.02), "22": (0.03, 0.05), "33": (0.10, 0.20), "44": (0.005, 0.01)}
    ok = True
    for name, extra in (("AGREE", {}), ("DISAGREE", {"33": 90})):
        l1, c1, l2, c2 = [], [], [], []
        for M in order:
            for cp in (1, 2):
                for p in A57.PHIS1:
                    l1.append({"job": 1, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": "sweep", "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "S"})
                    c1.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M]), 2000))
        ps = {M: v["phi_star_deg"] for M, v in A57.peaks(l1, c1, order).items()}
        for M in order:
            tW = thR[M] + extra.get(M, 0)
            for cp in (1, 2):
                for role, p, n in (("peak", ps[M], 3000), ("plus90", 90, 1500)):
                    l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "W-no", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "part": "W"})
                    c2.append(w_counts(0.9 * (1 - 0.9 * s2(p + tW)), n))
                    l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R1", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "R"})
                    c2.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M]), n))
                    l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "R0", "role": role, "phi_deg": p, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 0, "part": "R"})
                    c2.append(r_counts(0.01 + 0.9 * s2(p + thR[M] + 20), 1500, bits=1))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "W-ref", "role": "ref", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "part": "W"})
                c2.append(w_counts(0.9, 3000))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "Z", "role": "zero", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 5, "part": "R"})
                c2.append(r_counts(0.01, 3000))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "P10", "role": "readout", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 0, "part": "R"})
                c2.append(r_counts(ro[M][0], 1500, bits=1))
                l2.append({"job": 2, "M": int(M), "circuit": "P01", "role": "readout", "phi_deg": 0, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": 0, "part": "R"})
                c2.append(r_counts(1 - ro[M][1], 1500, bits=1))
        perm = rng.permutation(len(l2))                      # job 2 interleaved, as on the device
        l2, c2 = [l2[i] for i in perm], [c2[i] for i in perm]
        r = analyse(l1, c1, l2, c2, order, ps)
        rr = r["readout_measured"]
        ro_ok = all(abs(rr[M]["P1_given_0"] - ro[M][0]) < 0.02 and abs(rr[M]["P0_given_1"] - ro[M][1]) < 0.03 for M in order)
        good = r["H62"].startswith(name) and r["joint_generator_repeats_analyse_53"] and ro_ok
        ok = ok and good
        print(f"job 2 with the readout circuits, built to {name}: got {r['H62']} | phi* {ps} | informative {r['informative_cells']} | d1 "
              f"{ {c['M']: (round(c['d1'], 3), [round(x, 3) for x in c['d1_ci90']]) for c in r['cells_phi_star']} } | readout stated {ro} | measured "
              f"{ {M: (round(v['P1_given_0'], 3), round(v['P0_given_1'], 3)) for M, v in rr.items()} } | Z {r['zero_wait_baseline_any_above_0.1']} above 0.1 | "
              f"joint generator repeats analyse_53 {r['joint_generator_repeats_analyse_53']} | {'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'}")
    return ok


def synthetic_survey():
    """The survey on 156 qubits at stated P(1|0) and P(0|1): S0 and S1, two copies each, interleaved; the survey code
    must recover each qubit's stated values and classify the 3% screen as stated on every qubit whose stated e lies
    clear of 3% (by more than 0.008)."""
    n = 156
    rng = np.random.default_rng(62)
    stated = {q: (float(rng.uniform(0.0, 0.03)), float(rng.uniform(0.0, 0.06))) for q in range(n)}
    for q in (5, 50, 100):                      # three qubits stated high, as the published table had them
        stated[q] = (0.25, 0.40)
    labels = [{"job": 0, "circuit": k, "copy": cp, "n_qubits": n} for k in ("S0", "S1") for cp in (1, 2)]
    perm = rng.permutation(len(labels))
    labels = [labels[i] for i in perm]
    counts = synthetic_survey_counts(labels, stated, rng)
    snap = {"qubits": [[{"name": "readout_error", "value": (a + b) / 2}, {"name": "prob_meas1_prep0", "value": a}, {"name": "prob_meas0_prep1", "value": b}]
                       for a, b in (stated[q] for q in range(n))]}
    rec = survey_record(labels, counts, snap)
    sv = rec["qubits"]
    shots = 2 * 2_000                           # two copies pooled per circuit

    def z(meas, p):
        return abs(meas - p) / max(math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / shots), 1 / shots)

    worst = max(max(z(sv[str(q)]["P1_given_0"], stated[q][0]), z(sv[str(q)]["P0_given_1"], stated[q][1])) for q in range(n))
    clear = [q for q in range(n) if abs(sum(stated[q]) / 2 - RO_MAX) > 0.008]
    screen_ok = all(sv[str(q)]["above_3pct_measured"] == (sum(stated[q]) / 2 > RO_MAX) for q in clear)
    high_ok = all(sv[str(q)]["above_3pct_measured"] for q in (5, 50, 100))
    pub_ok = all(abs(sv[str(q)]["published"]["readout_error"] - sum(stated[q]) / 2) < 1e-12 for q in range(n))
    good = worst < 4.5 and screen_ok and high_ok and pub_ok
    print(f"survey at stated readout on {n} qubits: largest |measured - stated| in standard errors {worst:.2f} (below 4.5: {worst < 4.5}); 3% screen as stated on the "
          f"{len(clear)} qubits clear of 3% {screen_ok}; the three stated high excluded {high_ok}; published values carried {pub_ok}; "
          f"{rec['summary']['n_measured_above_3pct']} measured above 3%, {rec['summary']['n_published_above_3pct']} stated above 3% | {'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'}")
    return good
